deep_dive.why_not_others: Criteria 1 and 2 both require active in-the-wild exploitation; no item this run has confirmed ITW exploitation of a newly disclosed CVE. The Rapid7 Check Point root-cause analysis would meet criterion 3 but ships as an update to existing coverage.

criticals_rationale: No item clears the critical bar. Desigo CC has a public PoC and unpatched families but a building-management platform is not typically internet-exposed and no scanning is verified; TeamCity and Airflow both have patches available with no exploitation; the Minnesota incident is an out-of-nexus active attack with unconfirmed attribution.
